# Joel Chang Design

> Industrial design studio and portfolio of Joel Chang (Tzu-I Chang).

Tzu-I Chang (Joel Chang) is a Taiwanese industrial designer based in St. Louis, Missouri. Specializing in bridging design vision with engineering feasibility to drive complex hardware from concept to mass production.

Currently Principal Industrial Designer at Tron Future Tech (remote). He has launched 8+ products across networking, defense products, and drone systems, with earlier work at Gemtek rebuilding in-house product design language for global telecom partners. Practice areas named on the site include DFM, UX, CMF, and brand identity, from concept through mass production.

Site: https://www.joel-chang-design.com
Contact: joe10912345@gmail.com
Profiles: https://www.behance.net/joe10912345, https://www.linkedin.com/in/joel-chang

## Projects

- [AI Tool Kit](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/ai-tool-kit): Integrating AI into the industrial design workflow since 2022.
- [Airgain FWA Easy Installation Kit](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/airgain-fwa-easy-installation-kit): An outdoor antenna installation solution: simpler installation, seamless connectivity.
- [Assistive products for children with dysarthria](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/assistive-products): Lightweight, modular training aids for children’s oral-muscle and speech exercises.
- [Geometry Series](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/geometry-series): Gemtek ID family: designed with order, built for modern living.
- [Interstellar 05](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/interstellar05): An esports PC chassis concept shaped with futuristic minimalism.
- [JCG Tough Welding](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/jcg-tough-welding): A cyberpunk-inspired welding machine concept for NLG’s design challenge.
- [Lionic LionFilter 200](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/lionic-lionfilter-200): A next-generation firewall designed from concept to delivery.
- [MoAI Router](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/moai-router): A Wi-Fi 7 AI healthcare router — technology that feels human.
- [NLG MMA200 / MMA120](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/nlg-mma200): Welding-machine exterior redesign balancing aesthetics and feasibility.
- [Ocean Series](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/ocean-series): A story-driven ID family for Gemtek’s Wi-Fi 7 portfolio.
- [Parametric Pattern Design](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/parametric-pattern-design): Experimental Rhino Grasshopper studies of parametric holes and surfaces.
- [SAGITTARIUS Laptop](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/sagittarius-laptop): Stay Professional. Stay Sharp. Stay Yourself — a business laptop concept.
- [T. SCOPE](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/scope): An AI-assisted scope system for target prediction (password-protected page on the original Wix site).
- [Speeder Pro Earbuds](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/speeder-pro-earbuds): High-performance gaming earphones with high-speed, zero-delay connection.
- [T. Blade](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/t-blade): An autonomous AI-powered reconnaissance drone for long-range mission awareness.
- [T. Interceptor CS](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/t-interceptor-cs): Autonomous swarm interception for safer, more secure airspace.
- [T. Interceptor MP](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/t-interceptormp): An autonomous AI-powered drone guarding airspace with speed and agility.
- [TEANA Earbuds](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/teana-earbuds): A CMF exploration of luxury earbuds in Morandi colors for women aged 25–35.
- [Wi-Fi 7 Gateway 2022](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/wi-fi7-2022): Gemtek’s first-generation Wi-Fi 7 routers: three identities, designed for the way you live.
- [Wi-Fi 7 Extender](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/wi-fi7-extender): Organic, biomimetic aesthetics in an ultra-compact Wi-Fi 7 extender.
- [Wi-Fi 7 Gaming Home Gateway](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/wi-fi7-gaming-home-gateway): Gemtek’s Wi-Fi 7 flagship: shaping performance into product identity.
- [Wi-Fi 7 HGU/AP](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/wi-fi7-hgu-ap): A router design drawn from the organic elegance of sea anemones.
- [ASUS Zenfone 9](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/zenfone-9): A smartphone CMF concept inspired by stage lighting, performance, and emotional contrast.

## Categories

- [Defense](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/defense): Site-security hardware for detecting and responding to unauthorized drone activity.
- [Networking](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/networking): Routers, gateways, extenders, firewalls, and ID families for telecom and enterprise.
- [Electronics](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/electronics): Laptops, esports PCs, smartphones, and earbuds.
- [Industrial](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/industrial): Welding machines, power tools, and business hardware accessories.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/lifestyle): Lamps, humidifiers, and experimental lifestyle objects.
- [Experimental](https://www.joel-chang-design.com/experimental): AI design tools, parametric pattern studies, and assistive devices.
